lines.en: One sweep of the tail and I slide into dark water.

lines.zh: 长嘴破开水面，几乎无声
lines.en: My long snout breaks the surface almost silently.
I creep along the riverbed.
My dorsal fin draws a faint line.
I know the waters of the Mississippi.
Weeds brush my flank.
I do not chase the current; I ride it.
My jaws open and close, tasting the water.
Mudbank ahead; I keep to the bottom.
I swim steadily, nothing like a fish.
I like the light in dark places best.
A flick of the tail turns me.
A crocodile's head, a fish's tail.
I drift up, then sink again.

lines.zh: 水底的声音我都听得见
lines.en: I hear everything along the bottom.
I never rush; I only patrol.

lines.zh: 腮边水流变急，我停一停
lines.en: The flow quickens at my gills; I pause.
My fin stands up like a little sail.
I hang in the water, motionless.
My snout points into the current.

lines.zh: 牙齿露在外面，不是我凶
lines.en: My teeth show; that is not anger.
I wait for small fish to come close.
The ripples push my shadow away.
I count the bubbles left in me.
Something bigger shares this water.
I release a small string of bubbles.
Light catches the scales on my head.
I am no fighter; so I wait.
When the water stills, I grow uneasy.
My back grazes the sandy bottom.
I open my jaws, almost like sighing.
I watch the shape on the bank.
I raise my long snout from the water.
You stand at the water's edge—too near.
My eyes sit atop my head.
I turn toward you slowly.

lines.zh: 那双鳄鱼似的眼在打量你
lines.en: Those crocodile eyes are sizing you up.
Coming in? Think it through.
I lift half my head above water.
I have more teeth than you think.
The water is mine; the bank is yours.
I sink out of sight; do not follow.

lines.zh: 我被咬了一口，翻身就跑
lines.en: Bitten, I roll over and flee.
One scale came loose.
That pushed me down half a body.
I tumble in the water.
It hurts, but I cannot cry out.
I burrow into the weeds.
Everyone in this water is fiercer than me.
I swim away on my side.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，很快淡了
lines.en: Blood blooms in the water, then fades.
I wedge myself under a stone.
There is a faint scent on the water.
I will not come ashore; throw it down.
That thing drifts on the surface.
I fix on it and drift nearer.
Careful; my jaws are wide.
Feed me if you like, but do not reach.
The fish here do not fill me.
I nudge it, then withdraw.
That will not fill this mouth.
If it drifts to me, I take it.
I bump your ankle and slide off.
I cloud the water as I turn.
You stepped on my back.
I thrash my tail in alarm.
A knock and my scales rattle.
The hollow is narrow; I cannot back off.
I swim along your leg.
That stirred the mud up.
Do not block my way.
The shove rolls me over, pale belly up.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一块石头转
lines.en: We circle the same stone.
Matters in the water need no words.
She is longer than I am; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 两尾并游，水纹合成一道
lines.en: Two fish swim as one wake.
This spawning ground is quiet.
We guard the same shallows.
I do not compete; I follow.
The spot is hidden in the weeds.
One ahead, one behind, all day.
Companions are few; I value this one.
I take it in my jaws, then spit it out.
Not food; back it goes.

lines.zh: 我用长嘴把它顶到岸边
lines.en: I nudge it to the bank with my snout.
It sank; let me look.
Whatever sinks is mine.
I hold it a moment to test it.
It is stuck between my teeth.
It is hard to lift, but I manage.
A little thing glinted.
I pin it under a stone.
That scent; I have it.
You entered the water; that counts.
I am no chaser, but I can wait.
The bend has only one exit.

lines.zh: 我的嘴对准了你的方向
lines.en: My jaws have found your direction.
My snout dips; I ready myself.
You stand out in the shallows.
Do not kick; that calls me.
Eyes fixed, tail taut.
This stretch is my territory.
Still following; the wake is mine.
The heavier you tread, the clearer you are.
I pass underneath.
Not fast, but I do not lose you.
Water slows me; it slows you too.
I wait for you to reach deep water.
Your shadow wobbles on the surface.
I hug the bank's edge.
I know this loop better than you.
Do not think I gave up.
I snap my long jaws shut.
This bite comes from below.
My teeth are fine, but many.
I wrench my head and tear.
Once I bite, I do not let go.
Water sprays all over you.
I am no hunter, but I still bite hard.
That bite went a bit wide.
I roll and bite again.
Your taste fills my long jaws.
I rise out of the mud.
The surface breaks over my back.
I was always in this river.
Snout first, body after.
I shake the water off my back.
Another quiet spot on the riverbed.
I have returned to my old rounds.
Sunlight comes through the water; it is warm.
The other waters were too crowded.
Nobody competes with me here.
I lift my head and blow out a breath.
One more shadow in the water.

lines.zh: 水面发烫，我只能往下沉
lines.en: The surface burns; I can only sink.
I land on dry ground with my jaws open.
The water is too shallow; I choke on air.
The bed shakes; my head rings.
An arrow sticks in my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 那力量顺着水传到我身上
lines.en: That force travels through the water to me.
So hungry I would bite the weeds.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我全身发麻
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and numbs me.
No water here, only falling.
